balls.text: this is an outstanding catch from Gambhir. Morne misses the yorker outside off, ends up bowling a full toss. Below the waistline, though, the TV umpire confirms it as well. Mitch backs away and slices it. Gauti leaps across to his left from backward point and completes the catch of the innings. He also intercepted a four there
near yorker outside off, he can't reach out and lay bat onto it, they sneak in a bye

They hustle for a couple, fine throw from Tendo, Robbie whips the bails off. Bailey gone for 60. This low full toss was drilled down the ground. Bailey wants a couple, Tendo collects the ball quickly from long-off and fires a throw to the keeper. Robbie moves to his left, gathers it on the second bounce and catches Bailey short
Bailey shuffles across and aims to lap-scoop it away but is struck on the pad and falls over as his balance is shot. He is down on the floor, the non-striker wants a single, they can't get it

Tendo just finger-tips it over at the long-off boundary and Bails collects the orange cap. Morne does not get hold of the yorker, low full toss, dispatched over vacant mid-off. Long-off was in picture, but can only tip it over
back of a length and on middle, worked in front of square on leg

Axar finds Surya, much like Gurkeerat. He bends down for a massive slog-sweep over leg, but can only skew it to long-off off the base of the bat. Narine's first wicket in this IPL after his action was rubber-stamped
darted shortish, heaved to deep midwicket
back of a length and outside off, flashed to long-off, another couple
fifty for Bails. Slid through on middle and leg, pushed in front of wide long-on off the back foot. He wants a couple and hustles across
slid through far too wide outside off, Bailey can't reach out and connect, the keeper can't collect it cleanly as well
fuller and on middle, mistimed slog sweep to the leg side

Bailey in the act again. This was fired full as well, Bailey shovels it, bisecting the gap between deep midwicket and long-on. AB de Villiers nailed the same gap a few days ago with a swatted hit. Surya (long-on) and Chawla (deep midwicket) the fielders there. Surya's dive ends in vain
too much width outside off, Bailey takes foll toll of it, smashing it away behind point, Russell can't fly across from sweeper and cut that off
back of a length and cuts it, chops it to the left of Robbie

Umesh Yadav has his third wicket. His inclusion has made a difference. This was fuller and on middle, whipped away straight down the gullet of Surya at long-on.  Not middled, hit high on the bat and he holes out
Umesh's yorker translates into a low full toss, which is forced to long-on
back of a length and just outside off, guided to point for a quick single. KKR needed a direct hit there
Bailey connects now and connects well. Tossed up googly outside off, Bailey's eyes lit up as a kid's does while listening to fairy-tales, smeared over long-off, deposited into the sightscreen
tossed up nicely, Bailey misses the slog-sweep and wears it on the pad. Outside the line of off and Chawla's animated lbw appeal amounts to nothing
skiddy ball outside off, scuttles low. Did not bounce at all. Bails swings and misses
flat and quick on middle and leg, whipped through midwicket
clean, crisp and effective. Bails touches gloves with Gurkeerat. Tossed up on off, he marmalises a six over long-on. Beautifully lofted, Miller applauds from the dug-out
flat and on off, shovel-driven to long-on
Bailey sinks to one knee and slog-sweeps it in front of square on the leg side. This was tossed up on middle and leg
darted flat and quick, Bailey is stuck on the back pad, this was sliding down
dabbed in front of point with an angled bat
skids off the deck with some extra bounce and catches Gurkeerat on the front pad. This did not threaten the stumps
fuller on middle, patted back to the bowler
shortish and dragged outside off, he clunks a cut to sweeper. Bailey wants two but is sent back as Russell swoops in on the ball
short and wide, cut to sweeper off the back foot
quicker and outside off, it was the wrong'un, Gurkeerat employs the latest of late cuts and finds short third
fuller and outside off, he strides forward and pushes it to the covers
slid through on off, drifts in, milked down to long-on. Bailey looks for the second, he can't get it
pitched up and outside off, driven towards wide mid-off
Bailey uses his feet and drills it to long-off

Crucial strike. Thisara is a dangerous batsman at the death. Russell delivers another short bumpy ball, Thisara backs away and mishits the attempted cut, finds Manish at backward point. He hops up and takes it
dug in short on off, Bailey rocks back and unleashes a strong pull in front of square on the leg side. The man from deep midwicket runs across to his right and keeps it to one
back of a length and outside off, lashed to the covers. Gambhir has a shy at the non-strikers' and misses. A direct hit could have consumed Thisara
might have been a cross seam short ball, Thisara backs away, but can't ramp it over. Beaten
skiddy short ball climbs on middle at 140ks, beats Thisara's slice, surprises Robbie as well. That boinged off the surface, four byes
banged in short and on middle, Thisara sits on the back foot and pummels a six over deep backward square leg
short and outside off, Bailey should kick himself for not putting that away. Cut tamely to point
Chawla gives this more air on off, Bailey strides forward and blocks it back to the bowler
flatter and on middle and leg, now it's Thisara's turn to shovel one to long-on
quicker and outside off, shovelled down to long-on
straight roller on middle and leg, whipped down to long-on for one
very full and on off, Bailey skelps a drive to long-off
pacy bouncer from Umesh, Thisara ducks under and lets it go
back of a length and on middle and leg, whipped away through midwicket

Maxi has holed out, Russell pulls off a stunning catch, diving forward from sweeper. Maxi makes room and carves it in the air, Russell runs forward, takes Maxi's flat hit and tumbles onto the ground. Maxi examines the bottom of the bat as he trudges back
mighty full and on off, tapped in front of the covers for a quick single. KKR needed a direct hit there, Yusuf has a shy at the non-strikers' and misses
back of a length and outside off, Bailey arches back a bit and slaps it to the right of sweeper cover. Russell runs across, slides in vain
very full and down leg, almost a full toss, wided
yorker at the base of middle, Maxi backs away and digs it out. Smart stuff from Umesh
shortish and on middle and leg, punched down to long-on for one
fuller and wider outside off, sliced over the covers. Umesh from sweeper runs across and mops it up
floated on off, worked to short fine leg off an inside edge
Bailey uses his feet and drills it back at the bowler
looped up outside off, dabbed in front of point
pushed through outside off, slapped away to long-on
mighty full at the base of off, jabbed to the left of mid-on. Umesh fumbles and concedes a couple, where there should have been just one. It happens in the IPL
back of a length, this enjoys some extra bounce outside off, wobbles away as well to mess with Maxi's attempted dink to third man. Beaten
banged in short and outside off, Bailey switches his balance onto the back foot and pulls it over midwicket. There is protection in the deep, though
back of a length again, whipped down to long-on
angry bouncer from Russell, flies to the keeper, who leaps and gloves the ball. Ducked under
swing and a miss to a back of a length ball outside off
on a fuller length and on middle and leg, Glenndeep Singh Maxi goes back and across as he whips his wrists and lifts it over backward square for a flat six. Smokin'
back of a length and outside off, squeezed to long-on off the bottom part of the bat
slid through quicker, catches Maxi on the pad as he can't flick it away, but this was heading down leg
pushed through outside leg as Maxi pre-meditates a reverse-slap and misses. The ball beats the keeper and runs away fine
flighted and loopy from Narine, Maxi backs away a touch, steps out and slices it through the covers, beats long-off to his left
fuller and on off, eased down to long-on
straighter on off, nurdled to the right of short fine
back of a length and outside off, slapped away to deep cover for one

What a clanger! Yusuf drops a sitter. Banged in short and outside off, Maxi top-edges the pull and shoots it up in the air. Yusuf takes his eyes off it at deep midwicket and puts it down. Pops in and pops out.  How costly will that turn out to be?
low full toss and Russell seeks the base of off, sliced to the covers
fuller and on middle and leg, glanced to short fine
back of a length and skids through outside off, flat-batted back to the bowler. Not much power behind that
angled in fuller on middle and leg, tucked to midwicket, finds the fielder
quicker through the air again, a tad short. Punched off the back foot towards cow corner. Russell mops it up
this Narine offering skids off the deck and hurries on middle. Maxi brings his bat down and whips it away through midwicket
floated up and on off, pushed to the covers
fuller on middle and leg, blocked back to Narine
shortish and outside off, Maxi wants to lash it away, chops it to the covers
slid through outside off, left alone
back of a length and outside off, Bailey gets on top of the bounce and cuts it to the left of point, diving save
Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V of the previous ball as Morne explores the channel outside off
back of a length, extra lift outside off, Bailey lets it be
back of a length with some away shape outside off, Maxi reads it and pokes it to deep third man
back of a length and outside off, Maxi stands up tall and balanced as he punchily drives it through the covers, away she screams to the boundary
length delivery outside off, Maxi, having backed away, has enough leverage to smash it to the long-on boundary. Flat and powerful, six
dug in shortish and cramps Maxi for room, mistimed paddle in front of short fine
dug in on a back of a length, tap-and-run single in front of the covers
dropped shortish and sliding across off, Bailey belts it between the covers and point
dug in short and outside off, Bailey swivels on the back foot with the balance of a ballet dancer and pulls it to the right of mid-on. Put away!

Kings XI have been reduced to 27 for 3, sharp work from Chawla. Sehwag wants to whip this length ball on middle and leg away, does so. But Chawla dives to his right at square leg and pulls off a smart, low catch
width on offer outside off, Viru latches onto it. On a good length, Sehwag punches with an open face and nails the gap and cover-point and point
greets Maxi with a bumper, flies through to the keeper. Maxwell jerks his head out of the way

Morne strikes! On the customary back-of-a-length side is Morkel, Saha hunts for another pull. This was not all that short to warrant the stroke. He can't connect well this time, much like the previous attempt. Gets a bottom-edge onto the thigh, rebounds to Yusuf at a widish slip position
back of a length and on middle and leg, tucks Viru up for room. Nudged in front of midwicket
on a good length and outside off, Viru opens the face of the bat and glides it fine on the off side. Chawla runs across from square third man, slides in vain
back of a length and jags back in on middle as Morne pounds in and hammers the deck. Viru is up on his tippy toes as he defends it back to the bowler
short and rises over the stumps, Viru jumps across off, pulls and meets with thin air
pushed into the covers

he does not middle the pull. But collects a six. Top-edge and top-edges give way to sixes in  T20s. Climbs disconcertingly, Saha manages a top-edge that balloons over backward square leg. Umesh's pace assisted Saha there
on a length and outside off, the angled bat glides it towards third man
Saha connects with the pull and reaps reward. Short and directed at the body, Saha swivels and pulls it over backward square leg, deep square leg can't cut that off. One-bounce four
fuller and curling away outside off, pushed defensively to point
back of a length and skids on to Saha, who manages a bottom edge on the attempted pull, the ball rolls to leg
shortish again, defended to the helmeted backward short leg
banged in short and hurries onto Sehwag, he hops up and seeks it to turn it to the leg side. Lobs it to where a forward short leg may have been
pitched up and outside off, Saha reaches out and drives it to third man
shortish and hurled on the leg stump, Viru leaps off his feet and paddles it to the left of the keeper off the inner part of the bat
143.7kph, veering onto the pads, dribbles in front of square on the leg side. Russell comes into the picture again. Off the pad
And Morne gets Sehwag hopping straightaway. Short and ruses on top of off, Sehwag quells it in front of square on the off side and trots off to the other end
tucked behind square on the leg side for a couple. Saha and Kings XI off the mark
near yorker at the base of off, Saha jabs his bat down and keeps it out

Vijay perishes for a duck! Back of a length and on middle and leg, Vijay chips it feebly, Russell runs forward from midwicket and completes a good catch. The extra lift from Umesh foiled Vijay's stroke
back of a length and angles in on off, Vijay inches forward and blocks it back to Umesh
pitched further up and just a shade outside off, driven to mid-off
back of a length and zipping away just outside off with some extra lift, Vijay has a nervy waft at it, watches the ball beat the outside edge

Chawla sealed it for KKR in the final last year! He seals it for KKR tonight! PC pushes at this back-of-a-length ball outside off, gets a thickish outside edge that runs away past the two-man slip cordon. Yusuf pumps his fist. Surya hugs Russell in the dug-out

Mitch pegs the middle stump back, bags the consolatory wicket of Russell. Fuller length and fired though by Mitch, Russell has a huge slog and misses. The bowler hits the stumps. Timber, but all too late. Russell takes high-fives and hugs from his team-mates in the dug-out. What.a.knock
Mitch does not nail the yorker. Mighty full and outside off, drilled to long-off. Robbie applauds from the dug-out
very full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover
angled outside off from round the stumps, Yusuf employs finesse and dabs it to deep third man
fuller and on middle and leg, he forces it to the long-on boundary with a drilled drive. Those powerful arms of Russell could even wrestle an aligator
not in the blockhole now, fuller on the leg stump, clipped to long leg
Russell backs away a bit, Anureet fires a yorker at the base of the leg stump, yet Russell whips it to long-on
yorker at the base of middle and leg, jammed out in front of square on the leg side
low full toss on the pads, whipped to long leg
fuller and outside off, Anureet draws the outside edge, runs away past a diving Saha
full toss on off, pushed to long-off
Oops, Maxi has shelled it. This was a dolly. Another full toss, he does not middle it. Slices it high in the air. Maxi takes his eyes off it and drops it at mid-on. Pops in and pops out
Russell has smoked that! Low full toss on middle as the yorker goes wrong. He goes low on one knee, gets under it and launches it high and over long-on
slowy ball on off, Yusuf picks it and pats it in front of the covers for one
very and outside off, he ventures deep in the crease and drills a drive to deep cover

back of a length and outside off, Russell sinks to one knee muscles away to the long-on boundary for a rapid fifty even as the fielder moves to his left. He fails to stop the ball after putting in a dive
short and sliding across off, Yusuf waits on it, uses the pace on it and ramps it away through the unmanned slip cordon, short third man had no chance as well. These two are turning it on for KKR
yorker on the leg stump, jabbed down to long-on
mighty full and outside off, thwacked towards sweeper cover. Russell wants a couple and gets it
slowy short ball, semi paddled and semi pulled through midwicket
low full toss on the pads with a label 'help yourself' Yusuf obliges and whips it away to the left of the man patrolling the boundary at deep midwicket
fuller and on middle, driven back at the bowler

low full toss as Mitch does not meet with the yorker, pushed to Axar at the covers. Yusuf drifts off for a single, Axar has a shy at the stumps at the non-strikers' and misses, again. A direct hit would have caught Yusuf miles short
pitched up on middle, comes in with the angle, driven down to long-on for a single
angled in fuller and on off, pushed into the covers. Yusuf wants a single, Russell says no. Yusuf retreats, Axar misses the direct-hit
mighty full and outside off, Yusuf lays into a drive and sends it scurrying past mid-off. The fielder dives to his left but can't stop the ball
pitched further up and outside off, double bluff, looked like the change in pace as well. Tapped in front of point
shortish and outside off, Russell backs away, thumps a cut behind point, beats the fielder. Defeats deep third man as well. Mitch scratches his head
arm-ball on middle and leg, whipped down to long-on for one
flat and quick on off, he flat-bats a drive between long-off and deep cover. Anureet runs to his right from deep cover and cuts it off
Axar gives it more air, driven down towards long-off
Axar errs short and wide outside off, Russell ventures deep in the crease and slaps it to the right of backward point
that's out of earth, fetch that in Mars. Flatter and angled outside off, he sinks to one knee and slog-sweeps it into the stands over deep midwicket
flatter and quicker, Russell takes a stride forward and hacks it away to the deep midwicket fence, more off the inside half, not middled
full toss outside off, not a pin-point yorker, Russell reaches out and carves it to off and retains strike
Thisara does not get the yorker right, mighty full and outside of, swing and a miss from Russell
yorker outside off, just inside the tram-line. He backs away and fails to dig it out
bouncer from  Thisara, ducked under, one for the over
another of those slower ones outside off, Russell spots it and smears it over the covers for a one-bounce four. Flat hit and it clatters away
loopy slower delivery on off, bunted in front of the covers for one
Perera errs in line, drifts this slower one down leg
yorker seeking the base of off. It seemed destined to nail off but Russell's jab intervenes. Kept out
shortish and lifts on middle, Russell backs away, deals with the extra bounce and flashes a cut behind point, beats third man to his right
mighty full and outside off, much better from Mitch. Russell has an almighty swing at that but does not connect
back of a length and outside off, Russell sits back and hammers it through the covers. Sweeper cover runs to his right, don't bother chasing that
shortish and hurries on off, cramps Yusuf for room. Tap and run in front of the covers for a hustled single
pitched up and around off, Yusuf slices the drive in front of point
back of a length and outside off, he hops up but can't slice it away. Beaten
bumpy short ball outside off, another crude slog and a miss
back of a length and outside off, Russell swings and misses. He throws his head back for not connecting that
on a fuller length and outside off, Russell brings the axe and daggers. He clears his front leg and flat-bats it to the right of the man diving at short cover
squeezed down to third man with an angled blade
back of a length and outside off, slapped to point
darted on the stumps, blocked back to the bowler
slid through outside off, Russell cuts, gets an edge, rebounds to third man off the pad of Saha
squirted to the leg side for one
arm-ball snakes in with the angle, Yusuf takes it on the pad
quicker on off, dabbed in front of point
round-armed on off, toe-ends the drive back to the bowler
fuller and on middle, Russell shuffles across, works to short midwicket and averts the hattrick

Tendo out. Sandy's in-ducker does the trick again. KKR sink to 60 for 5. This was on a good length and comes in on off, Tendo aims for an across-the-line flick and misses, plumb in front. Thanks for coming, Tendo. Oh wait, replays reveal that Tendo had gotten an inside-snick on to front pad. Unfortunate..

Gauti flashes, connects and nicks off. KKR's chase has been derailed. This was on a length and angling away outside off again, Gauti swishes and manages a bottom-edge, which is gobbled up easily by Saha
back of a length and darted across off, GG is crease-bound as he slashes and misses
full and wide outside off again, GG bends his knee and thrashes a drive to short cover. Could have placed that better
fuller and outside off, driven to point with an open face
Yusuf greeted by a bumper, he sinks under it

What.a.catch from Saha. He said keeping was his primary skill and he shows it off. This looked like a legcutter that gripped in the pitch, did not come onto Surya, bounced extra as well. He looks to guide it away through the slip cordon but makes a mess of it. Off the face of the bat and pouched by Saha, diving across full-length to his right. End of a charming cameo from Surya. Replays show that it was the back-of-the-hand slower one
shortish and outside off, GG hangs back and slaps it to the off-side sweeper
back of a length and on middle, turned right of midwicket for one
back of a length and outside off, Surya waits on it and plays a nifty little glide through the vacant slip cordon
leg stumpish, tucked behind square on the leg side
Another, Surya special. He shuffles across and launches another leg-stump ball over backward square. Phew, how do you play that man and that too against Mitch?
Mitch slips in a slower one, Surya waits on it and nudges it to leg

fuller and on middle and leg, squeezed behind square off the inside half of the bat. They ran the first one hard and made the second with ease. Dunno why it went to the third umpire. There was a near collision between Surya and GG. Otherwise it was very sharp running between the wickets
Whoa! Back of a length and on leg stump, Surya jumps across off, picks it up from there and flicks it over long leg. Surya special, that
back of a length and on off, GG absorbs the pace on that with soft hands and drops it in front of point for a speedy single. Surya calls, GG responds, they get it with little trouble
fuller and hurled in on off, pushed to the off side
shortish and skiddy outside off, Surya uses the pace on it and ramps it past first slip, beats deep third man as well with a healthy helping of cheek
fuller and around off, defended to off with an angled bat
length ball, defensively pushed down the track

how soft was that? This was back of a length and comes in on middle and leg, Manish aims to flick it away. Instead he chips it to Bails at short midwicket. Almost similar to Vijay's wicket. This may have stuck in the pitch and stopped on Manish. He rehearses the flick as he walks back
fuller and wider outside off, thrashed past backward point, skims away to the boundary
Axar leaps, finger-tips it over for a one-bounce four. Manish takes a step forward and swings it over Axar at backward square leg. Axar nearly pulled it off
swish and a miss to a back-of-a-length delivery outside off
Anureet responds with a bouncer, flies to the keeper after beating Gambhir's pull. One bouncer for the over
fuller and wider outside off, GG throws his bat at and slices it up and over the two fielders at point. Runs away to the boundary
back of a length and darted across off, Gauti flashes and nails it. Another miss
good length ball outside off, moves away. Manish meets this with an open face too, dabbed to third man
fuller and outside off, square-driven to point via an open face
stump-to-stump line, patted back to the bowler after pressing forward
back of a length and sliding across off, he skips out, slashes and only connects with thin air
on a length and on off, sliced up and over backward point

inswinger from Sandy, Manish pushes and gets an inside edge that sneaks away fine after passing the stumps. Axar slides in the deep, but was he in contact with the ad boards while doing that. No, that's a clean stop, says the TV umpire
Sandy pins Robbie lbw. This was fullish and on off, Robbie shuffles across off and does not meet with the flick, rapped on the front pad. Struck in front of off and he has to depart. Sandy exults

on a length and outside off, flashed to point, straight to the fielder. They look for a single but decide against it, the fielder at covers, Vijay I guess, has a shy at the non-striker's. Ricochets off GG's pad onto the stumps, but he is in
back of a length and around off, punchily blocked to the covers.
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket
back of a length and outside off, cut away, Maxi dives to his right and stops the ball. Axar and Vijay pat him on the back
swerving down leg, helped away very fine on the leg side with a flick of those dexterous wrists. Fine leg is a bit too square and Robbie is aware of that
on the leg stump, GG can't glance it away. Off the pad and rolls to short fine
back of a length and on middle, defended to the left of the bowler
peachy stroke from Robbie. Fuller and on middle and leg, he leans across and pootles a flick as though it is the first thing he does every morning. Beats short midwicket and mid-on with ease

There's a foot race between Sandy and Robbie. Robbie wins the race, he is in. Good length on middle, defended gently to the off side, adjacent to the pitch. GG sets off, Robbie replicates and makes his ground even as Sandy rushes onto the ball, tumbles and under-arm flicks it to the strikers'
back of a length and holds its line outside off, punchily driven past short cover. Mid-off has it covered, though
pitched up, this one goes the other way - outswinger - pushed defensively to short cover
back of a length and swerves in on off, Robbie accounts for the movement and blocks it back to Sandy
back of a length and swings back in on off, Robbie squirts a single behind square, towards fine leg via a closed bat-face. He realises the possibility of a second and gets it
